brief: We run waste collection for three municipalities with about 120 bin trucks. Supervisors want to see where every truck is during the day and get a warning when a truck skips a scheduled stop or stands still for too long. At the end of the day they need a completion report per route. All trucks use the same GPS tracker vendor.

Our credit union wants new members to join online instead of visiting a branch. They should photograph their ID and a proof of address, we check them automatically against watchlists, and staff in the back office approve or reject the cases the system is unsure about. Regulators sometimes ask us to explain a past decision, so we must be able to show who decided what and when.

We want a marketplace for used agricultural machinery. Dealers send us their stock as spreadsheets, buyers search by make, year, hours and specifications and send enquiries or offers. A buyer pays a deposit online and the dealer receives the money minus our commission. Dealers need their own area to manage listings and see enquiries.

A network of physiotherapy clinics wants a patient app where people book sessions, have video follow-ups with their therapist and get reminders for their home exercises. Therapists use a web panel to see their schedule and message patients. The app must be available in both app stores and health data must be protected.

Engineers at our firm waste hours searching through about 1,500 technical standards and old project reports. We want a chat tool where they ask a question in plain language and get an answer that points to the exact documents it used. Access to project reports must follow project team membership. Employees sign in through Microsoft accounts.

Our fitness software is used by hundreds of gyms. Gym owners keep asking for reports on attendance, class occupancy and membership churn inside our existing portal. They should be able to arrange their own dashboards, receive a weekly summary by email as a PDF, and of course each gym must only ever see its own numbers. Check-in events arrive continuously from all gyms.

Our elevator maintenance company needs an app for technicians who work in lift shafts without any signal: they fill in inspection checklists, take photos and collect customer signatures, and everything syncs when they are back online. In addition our customers should get a web portal where they see the service history of their lifts and download invoices.

We provide mandatory compliance training for regulated industries. Learners watch video lessons, take exams and receive a certificate. Before an exam the learner's identity must be verified through an external identity provider, and we must keep proof that the right person took it. Training managers want completion reports.

Doctors in our hospital need quick answers from clinical protocols and internal guidelines. We want an assistant that answers questions in plain language and always shows which protocol and section it relied on. Each department should only see its own protocols, and the tool has to work well on a phone browser during rounds.

We are building a digital freight platform. Shippers post loads, carriers bid on them, and once a load is awarded both sides follow the shipment on a live map using positions from the carriers' GPS providers. The platform collects payment from the shipper and pays out the carrier after delivery, keeping a fee.

Insurance brokers send us monthly policy and commission files in different formats. We want to import them, and give each broker a dashboard of their sales pipeline and commissions, with scheduled exports to Excel. Brokers must never see each other's data.

A coffee shop chain wants a loyalty mobile app: customers collect points by showing a QR code at the till, receive push notifications with personal offers, and see their reward history. Marketing needs a small admin tool to create campaigns. The app must integrate with the existing point-of-sale system.

A ski rental shop wants online reservations: customers choose equipment and dates, availability is checked against the shop's inventory, and a deposit is paid online. Staff see a calendar of pickups and returns and can mark items as out for service.

A city administration has decades of building permits on paper. They want the archive scanned, text extracted automatically, and a search portal where clerks and citizens can find permits by address, owner or date. Citizens can request a certified copy online.

We organise live quiz events in bars and conferences. We need a platform where a host runs the quiz from a big screen and up to 5,000 players join from their phones, answer in real time and see a live leaderboard. Hosts create their own quizzes ahead of time.
